name: Peak Manufacturing and Fulfillment
old_description: Single source solution delivering high volume, high quality manufacturing and fulfillment services to industrial and consumer product companies for almost 40 years
about:
Peak Manufacturing and Fulfillment was founded in 2015 in Englewood, Colorado. The company draws on nearly four decades of manufacturing and assembly experience, operating as an integrated production and fulfillment enterprise. No founder names or ownership structure are publicly disclosed.

The facility runs a standardized fleet of Nissei injection molding presses—hydraulic, electric, and hybrid—ranging from 22 to 720 tons, supported by robotics, automation, and secondary screws for clear polymer production. Personnel are trained in scientific decoupled molding and work with all thermoplastic materials. Beyond molding, Peak provides design and engineering consultation, prototyping, assembly and kitting, custom packaging, warehousing with 24/7 inventory visibility, and fulfillment and shipping services that leverage combined purchasing power for discounted carrier rates.

Peak serves medical device manufacturers, consumer and industrial product companies, and shelf-stable food brands. Its customers range from startups needing warehousing and automated shipping to mid-sized and large businesses seeking a single-source partner for design, production, packaging, and distribution.

The company emphasizes its "complex circular structure" that consolidates design, development, and distribution under one roof. Affiliation with sister company Caroba Plastics and packaging supplier Pozzetta Specialty Supplies extends purchasing power and packaging capabilities. Peak’s stated mission is to understand each client’s logistical needs and deliver simple, scalable solutions.
